lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular 2D grid posterior to the branchial region, following a predictable horizontal and vertical alignment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, with high-luminance blobs positioned at the intersection points of these bands and horizontal alignment axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, trailing white filament or potential scientific tag is visible near the posterior insertion point of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral surface of the left pectoral fin, with its posterior half extending beyond the fin's trailing edge.
